steering_lock_note: 400° steering lock confirmed from ACC 1.9.3 car fix (was incorrect in earlier builds).

TC1.notes: Lower = more intervention; pace-first picks minimum stable slip on exits.

TC2.notes: Tune with rear mechanical grip and diff exit; verify via TC spark counters in telemetry.

ABS.notes: Higher maps tolerate more slip under trail; align with brake migration.

tyre_traits.heat_character: Front axle slow to build heat; easy to begin stint under window.
tyre_traits.degradation_mode: Grain on front inside shoulder when under-temp or over-steered on cold tyres.

aero_traits.sensitivity: Fairly rake-sensitive; rear wing changes show clearly on high-speed rotation.
aero_traits.platform_notes: Keep platform stable before chasing damper extremes — mid-engine mass distribution favors rear grip on power.

shift_rpm.note: Placeholders — measure optimal shift points from stint telemetry (throttle, gear, rpm trace) per track.

auto_blip_on_downshift.what: ACC GT3 paddle downshifts auto-blip / rev-match. Motec THROTTLE shows brief spikes (often 20–70% for one sample) while BRAKE stays high.
auto_blip_on_downshift.not: Driver throttle, pedal overlap, ABS applying throttle, or intentional heel-toe.
auto_blip_on_downshift.how_to_detect: Spike coincides with GEAR decreasing under brake; thr returns to ~0 next sample. Correlate thr spike + gear−1 + brk>30.
auto_blip_on_downshift.coaching_rule: Never treat mid-brake THROTTLE spikes as driver input or overlap advice. Mask or ignore when scoring coast/overlap/pedal-gap.

ecu_maps.what: 296 maps 1–10 change throttle linearity only; peak power/consumption unchanged (Kunos ECU maps thread).
ecu_maps.coaching_rule: Do not coach map changes as power levers; only pedal feel / linearity.

tc3_on_dash.what: Dash may show TC3; not a usable garage control on 296.

notes: Fronts slow to temperature; prioritize window before balance chase (Coach Dave 296 guide).
Exits matter more than apex speed on many tracks (long next straights).
Rear can step on entry if trail is aggressive — amount of brake ≈ amount of entry OS (Nils).
Hairpins: brake mostly straight; very light deep trail; progressive throttle after car settles (~0.5 s), then commit — early power unloads front/works diff (Nils Imola notes).
Kerbs: unload inside / settle brakes before big kerbs; car recovers grip quickly after hits.
Steering lock 400° (ACC 1.9.3 fix) — ignore older 800° guides; line/apex cues assume 400°.
Rake: keep rear-front ride height delta modest; high rake can snap OS (Coach Dave).
TC: raise on green/wet track, lower as rubber comes in; don't use TC as the pace fix.

setup_json_schema_summaries.tyres: PRESSURE_* (psi cold in garage; validate hot via telemetry), CAMBER_*, TOE_*
setup_json_schema_summaries.aero: Ride height front/rear, wing front/rear angles

coaching_hints: Prioritize getting fronts into 70–100 °C before chasing rear aero balance.
26–27 psi hot dry band applies; reject legacy 27.5+ psi dogma from pre-1.9 meta.
